.. change::
    :tags: performance, orm
    :tickets: 13406

    Improved performance of :func:`_orm.subqueryload` result handling.  The
    related rows are now consumed as plain tuples, rather than by iterating
    a legacy :class:`_orm.Query`, which constructed a :class:`.Row` object
    and applied :meth:`_engine.Result.unique` to every row.  The
    de-duplication that :meth:`_engine.Result.unique` performed is now
    applied directly, keying the related object on identity and the parent
    key columns on value.  As a side effect, a ``yield_per`` execution option
    on a statement with a :func:`_orm.subqueryload` nested inside a
    :func:`_orm.selectinload` no longer raises ``InvalidRequestError``.
    Parent key columns of a datatype that sets ``hashable=False`` are now
    also de-duplicated by value, so duplicate subquery rows no longer
    produce repeated collection members.  Pull request courtesy Oliver
    Parker.
